title: ETR · Target details
description: Path topology, path changes, latency and loss for one etr target (source → destination).

panels.title: Target
panels.description: Reverse DNS name of the destination, as reported by etr (empty without PTR records).

panels.title: End-to-end loss
panels.description: Share of probes that did not get a reply from the destination over the last minute.

panels.title: Median RTT
panels.description: Median end-to-end RTT over the last minute, all selected flows.

panels.title: p95 RTT
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end RTT over the last minute.

panels.title: Jitter
panels.description: Smoothed RTT variation between consecutive probes (RFC 3550 style), averaged over flows.

panels.title: Paths in use
panels.description: Distinct paths currently used by the flows (ECMP spread).

panels.title: Path changes
panels.description: Times a flow moved to a different path in the selected time range.

panels.title: Path topology
panels.description:
All hops seen in the selected time range, laid out by TTL.

**Nodes**: average RTT and reply loss. Ring: green = replies, red = lost, grey = never replies, dark = only on paths no longer in use. Red outline = forwarding loss (loss that persists to later hops).

**Edges**: label is the RTT added by the hop, width is the number of flows, color is forwarding loss at the target (green < 1% < orange < 5% < red). Dashed grey edges belong to paths no longer in use.

Loss at a hop that does not carry on to the hops behind it is usually ICMP rate limiting, not real loss.

panels.title: Path per flow
panels.description: Which path (#N, see the Paths table) each flow used over time. A color change is a path change; gaps mean the flow was not running.

panels.title: Path change log
panels.description: Every time a flow moved to a different path, newest first. TTL is where the old and new path diverge.

panels.title: Paths
panels.description: Distinct paths seen in the time range. Numbers are assigned per target in order of discovery. RTT and loss are end-to-end for probes that took the path.

panels.title: End-to-end RTT per flow
panels.description: Average RTT to the destination per flow (source port). Flows on different ECMP paths separate here; path changes are marked as annotations.

targets.expr: sum by (src_port) (rate(etr_destination_rtt_seconds_sum{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (src_port) (rate(etr_destination_rtt_seconds_count{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: End-to-end loss per flow
panels.description: Share of probes per flow without a reply from the destination.

targets.expr: clamp_min(100 * (1 - sum by (src_port) (increase(etr_destination_reached_total{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (src_port) (increase(etr_probe_runs_total{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)), 0)

panels.title: End-to-end RTT distribution
panels.description: Histogram of destination RTT over time. Bimodal bands usually mean flows on paths with different latency.

panels.title: Jitter per flow
panels.description: Smoothed variation between consecutive end-to-end RTT samples (RFC 3550 style).

panels.title: RTT by hop
panels.description: Average RTT to each hop. Hop RTT includes the router's own ICMP generation time, which can be much slower than forwarding.

targets.expr: sum by (ttl, hop_ip) (rate(etr_hop_rtt_seconds_sum{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port", hop_ip!="*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ttl, hop_ip) (rate(etr_hop_rtt_seconds_count{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port", hop_ip!="*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Reply loss by hop
panels.description: Share of probes each hop did not answer. Loss that only shows up at one hop (and not the hops behind it) is ICMP rate limiting; compare with the Forwarding loss column below.

targets.expr: clamp_min(100 * (1 - sum by (ttl, hop_ip) (increase(etr_hop_received_total{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port", hop_ip!="*"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (ttl, hop_ip) (increase(etr_hop_sent_total{source="$source", destination="$destination", src_port=~"$src_port", hop_ip!="*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)), 0)

panels.title: Hop report
panels.description: MTR-style report for the selected time range. Reply loss = hop did not answer. Fwd loss = lowest loss at this or any later hop for the flows crossing it: an estimate of loss that is actually forwarded, with ICMP rate limiting filtered out.

panels.title: Flows
panels.description: One row per flow (5-tuple). Use the source port with e.g. `iperf3 --cport` to put test traffic on the same ECMP path.
